title: Customer answer
description: PERD §13 'Answer shape' and §40.1 (the overlay's Answer element): every final answer the customer sees, in six parts. It is what the core sends in the investigation response (last_answer) and in the SSE 'answer' event. Every text member carries no run of five or more digits (A154, REQ-SEC-003): masking happens in the core and the UI never receives unmasked data (REQ-UI-001). There is no member for model confidence, an internal reason code, a raw evidence payload or a policy threshold, and additionalProperties is false, so none can be added (PERD §40.1 'Never shown'). 'found' holds KNOWN facts only; whether a fact is KNOWN is decided by the core, not by this schema. 'done.verified' is true only when the core holds an ACHIEVED verdict for what is claimed (PERD §13, rule 6); the schema cannot check that. The list lengths are frame bounds, not policy. New in this contract set; no earlier contract changes (AGENT-15).

not_known.description: 2. What is not yet known, and why. 'I don't know yet, and here is exactly what I'm checking' is a successful answer.

done.description: 3. What Noema did, and whether that is verified.

advice.description: 4. What the customer should and should not do (for example, do not send the money again yet). Do-not advice is shown prominently.

next.description: 5. What happens next and when, as far as verified.

case_ref_masked.description: 6. A case reference, if one exists. Shown only after case_opened is ACHIEVED (PERD §40.1). Masked: no run of five or more digits.
